description: Opening training dataset: 20 representative variations each for the Ruy Lopez, Italian Game, Scotch Game and Fried Liver Attack. Every move has explanatory, plan-oriented commentary.

focus: what the move attacks or defends
why the piece/pawn is being placed there
what central break or development it facilitates
how it creates or prevents initiative
